title: I Recorded the Overnight Dumpster Pickup the Super Called Recycle Night

parts.text: I woke at 2:07 a.m. to the dumpster truck backing up under my window. The super had sworn pickup was 7 a.m. recycle night. I was thirty-five, floor 2, holding a phone and a baby monitor that was now just truck. I recorded two minutes of beep-beep and the company name on the hopper. Then I emailed the super and the city's noise inbox with the timestamp. At 2:14 he replied that trucks have union hours, and also that I should close the window. It was February. The window was closed.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: He wants a closed February window to beat a hopper against the brick.

social.video_title: 2 a.m. hopper, union hours, a closed window — Part 1/2
social.description: Baby monitor, promised 7 a.m., company name on the truck. Would you have gone back to sleep?

parts.text: The city tagged the hauler. Pickup moved to 7:10 a.m., which is not poetry but is sleep. The super posted a notice that blamed residents for overfilling, which we do not. I kept the recording. Union hours apparently include 7. The baby monitor went back to baby. Brick stopped shaking. Recycle night is now morning, a word I recommend to hoppers.

social.description: City tag, morning pickup, baby monitor restored. Was February a window?
